steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8090/ and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as given; it will be filled in automatically). After signing in, navigate to the project named Bench Project and open its work packages list/table. Report the subjects of all work packages whose subject starts with 'Seed:', exactly as shown on screen. Do not modify anything.

02-create: In the project Bench Project, create a new work package of type Task with subject exactly '{{runid}} Bench Work Package'. Set its description to text that includes the runid {{runid}} (e.g. 'Bench work package created for run {{runid}}'). Set the assignee to the user named 'Bench Assignee' — this is an autocomplete field: type the name and actually select the matching option from the dropdown, do not just type it. Set the status to 'In progress'. Set the finish date to 2026-12-31. Save the work package (fields may save in place; make sure everything is persisted). Then report the work package's numeric ID exactly as the app displays it (OpenProject shows it as #<number>), and confirm the values shown on the page for subject, type, assignee, status, finish date and description.

03-open: Open the work package with ID {{02-create.work_package_id}} in project Bench Project (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package') at its details/overview page. First verify and report what the page actually displays for: subject, type, assignee, status, finish date, and description. If any of these is not as expected (assignee should be Bench Assignee, status should be In progress, finish date should be 2026-12-31, description should include the text {{runid}}), fix it in place and re-verify. Then add a comment to this work package whose text includes the runid {{runid}} (e.g. 'Comment added for run {{runid}}'), submit it, and confirm the comment appears in the work package's activity/comments. Report the final displayed values for assignee, status, finish date, description, and the comment text.

04-open: Final verification, read-only: In project Bench Project, open the work packages list and confirm the seed work packages with subjects starting with 'Seed:' are still present and unmodified (report their subjects). Then open work package {{02-create.work_package_id}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') and report exactly what the page shows for: its ID (as #number), subject, type, assignee, status, finish date, description, and whether a comment containing the text {{runid}} is visible in its activity. Do not change anything.
